bug_locations: dependency_order: node set initialization (only keys included, referenced nodes missing)
dependency_order: ready-node selection (batch-appended all ready nodes instead of repeatedly choosing the alphabetically smallest available node)
dependency_order: cycle handling (silently broke out of the loop instead of raising ValueError)
explanation: Three interacting defects: (1) nodes=set(deps) ignored nodes that appear only in dependency lists, so referenced nodes were never emitted; the fix unions all referenced nodes into the working set. (2) Appending the entire sorted ready batch per round is not the same as always choosing the alphabetically smallest available node, because emitting one node can unlock a new node that is alphabetically smaller than other already-available nodes; the fix uses a min-heap so the smallest currently-available node is chosen at each step. (3) On a cycle the code hit `if not ready: break` and silently returned a partial order; the fix raises ValueError when not all nodes can be emitted.
